heading.en: What makes a plan a plan?

hook.en: A shop supervisor plans tomorrow's shifts; the CEO plans the next five years. Both are planning. Let us see the features they share.
hook.kn: ಅಂಗಡಿಯ ಮೇಲ್ವಿಚಾರಕ ನಾಳೆಯ ಪಾಳಿ ಯೋಜಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಮುಖ್ಯಾಧಿಕಾರಿ ಐದು ವರ್ಷ ಯೋಜಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಯೋಜಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಅವುಗಳ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡೋಣ.

body.en: Planning focuses on achieving objectives. It is the primary function of management. It is pervasive, required at all levels. It is continuous, futuristic, involves decision making, and is a mental exercise.

narration.en: Planning focuses on achieving objectives. It is the primary function of management. It is pervasive, required at all levels. It is continuous, futuristic, involves decision making, and is a mental exercise.
narration.kn: ಯೋಜನೆ ಗುರಿ ಸಾಧನೆಗೆ ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಕೃತ, ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯ ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಕಾರ್ಯ, ಸರ್ವವ್ಯಾಪಿ, ನಿರಂತರ, ಭವಿಷ್ಯಮುಖಿ, ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ.

title.en: On the board: planning comes first

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: Write the five functions of management. Planning comes first.
Every other function works inside the frame that planning draws.
Planning is continuous: plan, act, review, and plan again.
Other features: pervasive, futuristic, decision making and a mental exercise.

explanation.en: Planning is goal-focused, primary, pervasive, continuous, futuristic, choice-based and a mental exercise.

right.en: Every plan starts from a goal to be reached
Organising, staffing, directing and controlling all follow from it
The CEO and the foreman both plan
When this year's plan ends, the next one begins
It looks ahead and forecasts demand
It chooses the best of several alternatives
It needs thinking, foresight and judgement

body.en: Objectives, Primary, Pervasive, Continuous, Futuristic, Decision making, Mental exercise.

narration.en: Objectives, Primary, Pervasive, Continuous, Futuristic, Decision making, Mental exercise.

mnemonic.en: "Only Proper Planning Can Fix Daily Mistakes" (O P P C F D M)

problem.en: The principal of a PU college plans the academic year in May, the HoDs plan their department timetables, and the lecturers plan each week's lessons. Each year the calendar is revised. Which features of planning are seen?

steps.en: Principal, HoDs and lecturers all plan: planning is pervasive.
The calendar is revised every year: planning is continuous.
Plans are made in advance for the coming year: planning is futuristic.
